aliases: YHEGO Virtual Assets Exchange Service L.L.C
entity.summary: Dubai virtual-asset trading platform licensed to provide exchange services and broker-dealer services under the Yhego name.
entity.notes: Dubai's Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority lists YHEGO Virtual Assets Exchange Service L.L.C, with Yhego Technology Investment L.L.C in the operator name, under reference VL/26/06/001 with active status. Exchange services are permitted for institutional, qualified, and retail investors, while broker-dealer services are limited to institutional and qualified investors. The official site returned an access-control response during verification, so the URL is live_unverified rather than live_verified. No exact platform launch date is inferred from the licence issue date.
